name: razorflow
description: RazorFlow — general browser agent SDK and demo

scripts.build:sdk: npm run build -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-protocol && npm run build -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-browser && npm run build -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-client
scripts.build:all: npm run build:sdk && npm run build:extension
scripts.typecheck:sdk: npm run typecheck -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-protocol && npm run typecheck -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-browser && npm run typecheck -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-client
scripts.test:sdk: npm run build:sdk && node --test packages/razorflow-client/test/integration.test.mjs && node scripts/sdk-smoke.mjs
scripts.publish:sdk: npm run build:sdk && npm publish -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-protocol --access public && npm publish -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-browser --access public && npm publish -w @hardik21232323/razorflow-client --access public
